summary: Approved sequence sheets for the KM-12 related-substances HPLC validation (WA/2013/269) for Kalmorveth Pharma: parameter results against protocol acceptance, the specificity and forced-degradation challenge, and deviation notes. The co-eluting base degradant was resolved by a gradient change and the method passed specificity. Kalmorveth accepted the method for release testing.

properties.title: KM12 specificity and validation results Rev02

sheets.name: Summary
rows: Validation of the related-substances HPLC method for KM-12 drug substance release testing: linearity, accuracy, precision, specificity, range and detection limits. Sequence sheets for the approved run set, Rev02.
All validation parameters met the acceptance criteria in the protocol. The specificity challenge resolved the co-eluting degradant, and Kalmorveth accepted the method for release testing.
Method validation summary and acceptance criteria

rows.v: Method validation summary: KM-12 related substances

rows: Acceptance criteria as written in the validation protocol. Results reported to the precision stated in the protocol.

sheets.name: Specificity
rows: Acid, 0.1 M hydrochloric acid, 60 °C; duration and sample reference per approved stress protocol/sample-preparation record under {{PRJ0087:lims_id}}
Main peak resolved from the acid degradants.
Base, 0.1 M sodium hydroxide, room temperature; duration and sample reference per approved stress protocol/sample-preparation record under {{PRJ0087:lims_id}}
Degradant at the front of the main peak co-eluted in the first run.
Peroxide, 3% hydrogen peroxide; duration and sample reference per approved stress protocol/sample-preparation record under {{PRJ0087:lims_id}}
No new peaks above the reporting threshold.
Heat, 80 °C dry; duration and sample reference per approved stress protocol/sample-preparation record under {{PRJ0087:lims_id}}
Minor degradant resolved from the main peak.
Light, ICH Q1B exposure; duration and sample reference per approved stress protocol/sample-preparation record under {{PRJ0087:lims_id}}
Peak purity passed for the main peak.

The base degradant was resolved on 20 Feb 2014 by a shallower gradient slope. Source: approved KM-12 forced-degradation protocol and DN-01 specificity rerun sequence dated 20 Feb 2014, retained under {{PRJ0087:lims_id}}. Stress exposure durations, stressed-sample identities and injection positions are recorded in that protocol and its sample-preparation/sequence sheets; they are not transcribed here. Blank checks, main-peak/degradant resolution and peak-purity evidence are in approved rerun chromatograms and the reviewed sequence acceptance record. The method then proceeded to the full validation set.

rows: Base degradant co-eluted with the main peak in the first specificity run. Gradient adjusted and the run repeated; see the Specificity sheet.
